description: Use this when the user wants a 3D website, a walkable portfolio, a product showcase, a gallery, an exhibit, an event page or any interactive space they can share as a link. Creates the scene in their 3dCMS account and returns its id; then build it with apply_ops. With copyFrom it is a full COPY of one of their scenes (Save As), the way to try a big change on a new version while the original and its published site stay untouched. It opens in the 3dCMS editor; a copy is unpublished until publish_scene.

copyFrom.description: A scene id from list_scenes to copy every node, material and setting from. Omit for an empty scene.

name.description: A name for the new scene.

name: create_scene
title: Create a 3dCMS scene
